Rebuild is a NATIVE vertical clip (1080x1920, 4.4 s, no letterbox), which fixes the prior centre-crop FAIL. A 2 fps strip across the 3.02 s slot shows a real handoff: the envelope enters from frame-left, a hand reaches in and takes it (sealed, never opened) at about 0.5-2.0 s, then carries it out to the right. Every frame has the envelope in shot, so there is no empty-table stretch. The giver's hand stays off frame-left, which is normal framing for b-roll, not a clipping defect. Minor tone note, not a FAIL: banknote stacks on the table lean slightly toward 'cash payment'. The beat 'pass that digest through untouched' still reads literally.

Rebuild is a NATIVE vertical clip (1080x1920, 5.1 s), which replaces the earlier centre-crop fallback. A dusk drone climb up a lit rock ridge toward the peak, with a teal valley and a cloud band, fills the portrait frame with no bars. The 0.2 s and 2.9 s frames show the same clean composition with forward motion. It is twilight, not full night, which matches the slot name 'ridge-flight-twilight'. No text, no clipping.

1080x1920, a mobile-style single column with large type that reads at phone size. Both prior defects are fixed. (1) The Sep 22, 2026 'Bump version to v2.1.0 (#1139)' row and the Oct 13-16 block now share ONE screen. (2) The off-claim Oct 19 block is gone. The claim checks: there are exactly six commits from Oct 13 to Oct 16 (Oct 16: #1060; Oct 15: #991; Oct 14: #1074, #1148; Oct 13: #1135, #1099/#1142), and nothing sits between Sep 22 and Oct 13. Every card edge and every line start and end sits inside the margin (about 48 px on each side, about 85 px at the bottom). 'pagnated' is the real commit message's spelling, not a capture error. The white background is GitHub's page with dense content, not a blank capture.

1080x1920 portrait reframe with an audio stream and 20.5 s duration, which matches the spec span 30:05.0-30:25.5. The prior defect is fixed: the half-cut channel logo and the stray 'k' in the top-right corner are gone. A zoomed check of the top-right shows only screw marks on the wall. The face is centred with headroom, and the head, glasses and ears sit fully in frame at 1 s, mid-clip and 18 s. The attribution caption reads exactly 'Sivan Helfer, KCC-20 author, / June 2026, a week before Toccata'. It is on two lines inside a full-width dark band at about 71-80% height, every character sits fully inside the frame, and there are no em dashes. Soft source resolution is inherent to the webcam source. The spoken line ('create real assets on') is audio, so this frame cannot confirm it.
